metadata.description: A central repository of official skills and prescriptive plugins designed to provide a high-performance experience for building and deploying agentic applications across Google products and technologies.

plugins.name: alloydb
plugins.description: Create, connect, and interact with an AlloyDB for PostgreSQL database and data.

plugins.name: alloydb-omni
plugins.description: Create, connect, and interact with an AlloyDB Omni database and data.

plugins.name: bigtable
plugins.description: Connect, query, and interact with Cloud Bigtable.

plugins.name: cloud-sql-mysql
plugins.description: Connect and interact with a Cloud SQL for MySQL database and data.

plugins.name: cloud-sql-postgresql
plugins.description: Create, connect, and interact with a Cloud SQL for PostgreSQL database and data.

plugins.name: cloud-sql-sqlserver
plugins.description: Connect to Cloud SQL for SQL Server.

plugins.name: firestore-native
plugins.description: Connect and interact with Cloud Firestore.

plugins.name: data-agent-kit-starter-pack
plugins.description: This plugin provides a specialized suite of skills for data engineers and database practitioners working on Google Cloud. It acts as an expert assistant, allowing you to use natural language prompts in your preferred coding agent to architect complex data pipelines, transform data with dbt, write Spark and BigQuery SQL notebooks, and orchestrate end-to-end workflows across GCP's data ecosystem.

plugins.name: google-cloud-storage
plugins.description: Vetted Google Cloud Storage skills for your coding agent.

plugins.name: looker
plugins.description: Connect to Looker.

plugins.name: oracledb
plugins.description: Connect, query, and interact with Oracle Databases and their data within Gemini CLI.

plugins.name: spanner
plugins.description: Connect and interact with Spanner data using natural language.

plugins.name: knowledge-catalog
plugins.description: Skills for Knowledge Catalog.

plugins.name: dataproc
plugins.description: Skills for Dataproc.

plugins.name: bigquery
plugins.description: Data Analytics skills for BigQuery.

plugins.name: db-context-engineering
plugins.description: Context Engineering Agent for generating and maintaining QueryData / Conversational Analytics API context sets (templates, facets, value searches) for natural language to SQL tasks. Works with AlloyDB, Cloud SQL for MySQL, Cloud SQL for PostgreSQL, and Spanner.

plugins.name: google-cloud-core
plugins.description: Core Google Cloud guidance for coding agents: first-project onboarding, authentication and credential selection, and safety-critical validation for gcloud CLI commands. Includes the Google Developer Knowledge MCP server for grounded, up-to-date Google Cloud documentation.

plugins.name: google-cloud-well-architected
plugins.description: Google Cloud Well-Architected Framework guidance for coding agents, covering all six pillars: cost optimization, operational excellence, performance optimization, reliability, security, and sustainability. Use when designing or reviewing a Google Cloud architecture.

plugins.name: google-cloud-gke
plugins.description: Google Kubernetes Engine cluster guidance for coding agents: cluster creation and upgrades, application onboarding, manifest generation, networking, storage, backup and disaster recovery, observability, and production readiness. For autoscaling, cost, security, and AI workloads see google-cloud-gke-workloads. Includes the GKE MCP server for grounded access to the Kubernetes Engine API.

plugins.name: google-cloud-gke-workloads
plugins.description: Google Kubernetes Engine workload guidance for coding agents: autoscaling and compute classes, cost analysis and optimization, workload and platform security, multitenancy, batch and HPC, AI inference on GPU and TPU, and workload troubleshooting. Includes the GKE MCP server for grounded access to the Kubernetes Engine API.

plugins.name: gemini-enterprise-agent-platform
plugins.description: Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform guidance for coding agents: deploying agents and models, inference, tuning and tuning management, the model and skill registries, RAG Engine, the evaluation flywheel, endpoint, prompt, and alert management, migration from AI Studio, troubleshooting, the Gemini Agents API, and the Google Agents CLI. Includes the Agent Registry and Cloud Run MCP servers.

plugins.name: gemini-api
plugins.description: Gemini API guidance for coding agents: generating text and multimodal output with the Google Gen AI SDK, the stateful Interactions API for multi-turn conversations and background execution, and the Live API for realtime bidirectional streaming. Includes the Google Developer Knowledge MCP server for grounded, up-to-date documentation.

plugins.name: google-cloud-run
plugins.description: Cloud Run guidance for coding agents: deploying and configuring services for HTTP traffic, jobs for event-triggered and scheduled work, and worker pools for pull-based background processing. Includes the Cloud Run MCP server for grounded access to the Cloud Run Admin API.
